seo.title: Vessel Plan Approval & As-Built Documents | LASAN MARINE
seo.description: Preparing and completing approval documents for fishing vessels: missing calculations and drawings, plan review responses and as-built documentation.

fields.headline: Approval documents: plan review, as-built, missing items
fields.lead: You do not need to redo the whole set. We review it, point out what is missing or not to the rules, and add the calculations and drawings needed for approval.

items.context: The reviewer sent back a list of comments.
items.solution: We address each item and write the response.

items.context: The vessel as built differs from the design.
items.solution: Drawings and calculations updated to the vessel as built.

fields.heading: What you receive
fields.intro: Exactly the part of the set you need, ready for approval.
fields.note: Lead time is agreed with the quote, depending on vessel type, scope and existing documents. You know each delivery date in advance.

items.title: Review of your documents
items.desc: List of missing or non-compliant items

steps.title: Send us the brief
steps.desc: Vessel type, target dimensions, operating area and any photos or documents you have.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.desc: We agree the scope, deliverables and schedule, with a clear price for each part.

steps.title: Design and calculations
steps.desc: Drawings and calculations with industry software and our own engineering tools.

steps.title: Review and handover
steps.desc: We answer the reviewer’s comments, update the documents and hand over the final set.

items.title: Can you complete only part of the set?
items.content: Yes. We do only the missing items; a full redo is not required.

fields.heading: Stuck in plan review?
fields.description: Send us the reviewer’s comments or your current documents and we tell you what is needed.
